name: io.github.Arthurzxy/vivado-mcp-native
title: Vivado MCP Native
description: Native MCP server for controlling AMD/Xilinx Vivado on Windows and Linux via persistent Tcl.

environmentVariables.name: VIVADO_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a Vivado launcher, bin directory, or version directory.

environmentVariables.name: VIVADO_MCP_OUTPUT_ENCODING
environmentVariables.description: Optional Vivado Tcl console output encoding, such as utf-8 or gbk.
